in_sanskrit.name: Nafish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Fish in water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Nafish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Symbolizing the divine presence in water, Nafish is a name inspired by Hindu mythology. Derived from the Sanskrit term 'Nava-shya', meaning 'new fish', this name is believed to bring prosperity and success.
